style: An oil painting in the manner of nineteenth-century academic history painting: rich palette, dramatic chiaroscuro, visible brushwork, painterly and cinematic, 16:9 landscape. England and France between 1775 and 1793: tricorn hats, greatcoats, knee-breeches, buckled shoes, red caps and tricolour cockades after 1789, candle and lantern light, no modern objects, no railways. No captions, no lettering, no signature, no frames, no white margins, no black bars or borders.

beats.text: Night in the French countryside, 1789: a great stone château far off on a hill glows orange, firelight pouring from its windows against a black sky full of drifting sparks; in the village street below, the villagers stand quietly by the stone fountain, watching, lit by the distant glow; a lean peasant in a blue cap among them. Spectacular firelight, stillness.

Paris, 1792, at night, seen from an upper window: a large courtyard lit by torches where a rough crowd gathers around a great grindstone turned by two men, a shower of bright sparks flying from it; wild faces in the flickering light; an elderly banker in a flaxen wig looks down from the window, shocked. Lurid torchlight and sparks.
